notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
I tried to fix as many things as I could, but it probably won't be everything that was requested, but it's quite important things.

- The first thing is finally checkpoints, checkpoints are added in certain places, so it won't be necessary to continue from the beginning in some maps.

- A larger damage range has been added and the angle at which damage is taken should make it easier to hit a headcrab or a manhacks.

- Manhacks now only have 30 hp instead of 50, they should be killed in three hits with a crowbar or weapon

- Ambient were adjusted so that they didn't have any distorted parts and looped without any strange sounds

notes.title: Third time's the charm - Project Three is coming out on March 21st
notes.content:
[h3]Project Three is coming out on March 21st in Early Access after four years of development.[/h3]

[b]Project Three[/b] was announced on August 15, 2021. The development itself went smoothly, but the game struggled to find its identity.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ErY4xGdICyk

[h3]What has changed?[/h3]
Basically everything. There’s no point in listing it all here because everything the game was supposed to be has changed twice. Just read the description on the game page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895720/Project_Three/

[h3]Has the dev team changed?[/h3]
At first, I worked on it with someone else, but in the end, the final product is purely a solo effort. However, I still gave credit to the other developer because he did a great job.

Whether the project has lost or gained value compared to the first version of the game—I’ll leave that up to you.

[h3]Project Three - Third Time’s the Charm (Behind the Scenes) DLC[/h3]
As a tribute to two older versions of this game, I created a behind-the-scenes DLC that includes all the surviving and existing recorded videos of these versions. These are the only remnants of them, and they will probably never see the light of day.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3404310/Project_Three__Third_times_the_charm_Behind_the_scenes/

If you want, don’t forget to check out my previous game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2888540/AbsoluteFullLife
